title: Consideration of Existing Tenant Protections
description: The Subcommittee will consider staff analysis and recommendations regarding existing City of San Rafael policies including Cause Required for Eviction, Relocation Assistance, and Mandatory Mediation. This could significantly impact renters and landlords citywide by changing eviction processes and assistance programs.

title: ERF3, Homelessness, and Sanctioned Camping Area Update
description: The Subcommittee will receive an update on Encampment Resolution Fund (ERF) 3 and the City’s efforts related to homelessness, camping ordinance, enforcement, and interim shelter. This update likely involves discussion of resource allocation and policy decisions affecting the homeless population and the broader community.
